| Feature | Benefit |
|---------|---------|
| `AddHealthChecks().AddUrlGroup(...)` | Actively checks all 11 downstream services |

## Response format (standard Health Check API):
```json
{
  "status": "Healthy",
  "results": {
    "auth-service": { "status": "Healthy" },
    "user-service": { "status": "Healthy" },
    ...
  }
}
```

If any downstream service is unhealthy, `/ready` will return `503` with `status: "Unhealthy"` — Kubernetes will correctly keep the pod in `NotReady` state until all dependencies recover.
